title: We’re Hiring Interns | Multiple Positions
description:
WE ARE HIRING – JOIN OUR TEAM

Algonix is expanding its team and looking for passionate, creative, and motivated individuals who are eager to learn, innovate, and grow in a professional technology environment.

We are offering internship opportunities for individuals who want to gain practical experience, work on real-world projects, and develop valuable professional skills.

Open Internship Positions:

* Marketing
* Client Relations
* Graphic Designer
* Social Media Manager

Location and Work Mode:

Candidates from Trivandrum and Nagercoil are highly preferred.

Work Mode: On-site only (Remote opportunities are not available).

Why Join Algonix?

* Gain hands-on experience with real-world industry projects.
* Work alongside a passionate and collaborative team.
* Develop professional, creative, and communication skills.
* Get exposure to the technology and startup ecosystem.
* Build your portfolio and strengthen your career opportunities.
* Receive an internship completion certificate upon successful completion.

Who Can Apply?

We welcome students, fresh graduates, and aspiring professionals who are enthusiastic, responsible, creative, and willing to learn. Prior experience is an advantage but not mandatory.

If you are looking for an opportunity to develop your skills, contribute your ideas, and gain meaningful industry experience, Algonix is the place to begin.

How to Apply:

Interested candidates can send their updated resume and portfolio (if applicable) to the email address below.

Email: algonixpvtltd@gmail.com

Website: https://algonix.site

Phone: +91 9489603088

Email Subject: Internship Application – [Position Name]

Start your professional journey with Algonix.

Learn. Create. Innovate. Grow.

Algonix – Building Ideas, Empowering Talent.
